Host.title: List your apartment
Host.metaDescription: Posting is free, and the 5% fee applies only after a completed rental. How to list an apartment on Kvaterka.by.
Host.lede: Posting is free. The platform earns only once you have: 5% after a rental that both sides confirmed.

describe.title: Describe the apartment
describe.body: A draft saves itself at every step, so you can fill it in over several sittings.

photos.title: Add photos
photos.body: Photos are the main thing people look at. A listing can't be published without them.

dates.title: Set the dates and price
dates.body: The term is set as a range of nights, so one listing can work for a week or for several months.

moderation.title: Send it for moderation
moderation.body: We check the listing and publish it. If something's off, we send it back with a clear reason, not a rejection without explanation.

calendar.heading: The calendar is yours
calendar.bodyRich: Dates you've closed off can't be booked — that's a constraint of the database itself, not a check in the interface. Double-booking the same dates is also impossible — by construction, not by attentiveness.

requests.heading: Requests and responses
requests.body: The tenant sends a request, you respond. An unanswered request expires on its own — the tenant isn't left hanging, and you don't accumulate a backlog of overdue ones.

money.heading: Money
money.bodyRich: The tenant pays you the rent and deposit directly. The platform doesn't accept or hold them. The 5% fee is charged after the rental is completed — <link>more about the fee</link>.
